prompt:

Create ONE finished square Swedish vocabulary artwork for an adult mobile flashcard app. Use the Finnish iOS card style: vivid tactile realistic editorial illustration, memorable scale and clear action, warm light, cream header with fine gold edging, bold navy typography, integrated cream/gold memory-link caption, pale blue bottom example strip. Header text verbatim: "ett hus". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "house".
Scene: A bright yellow Swedish wooden house with a family at the front gate.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "hus resembles house.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "De bor i ett gult hus.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
styleReference: Established Swedish vocabulary card layout, described in the prompt; no image supplied to generation.
